rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Bitcoin (spot)
positions.catalyst: Pre-NFP positioning day: the July jobs report (Employment Situation) lands tomorrow Fri Aug 7 8:30am ET — a binary macro event that can gap 3x equity ETFs violently. No strong fresh catalyst today to justify leverage: the S&P/Dow sit at record highs (extended), semis are mixed (NVDA +1.2% and SMH +0.4% firm pre-market while memory — MU -3.4%, SK Hynix -6.1% — is the only clear weak spot, so no clean sector short), and ABNB/LYFT/NET report after today's close adding single-name landmines. BTC has recovered from the early-August dip, holding above its 20-day EMA with RSI ~65 and steady spot-ETF inflows absorbing supply; near-term resistance $66–67k vs support ~$63.9k/$62.7k gives modestly positive asymmetry.
positions.driver: LONG BTC-USD SPOT, 1x, 100% capital — the deliberate low-edge-day park. Strategy calls for lower-vol/spot when there is no strong fresh catalyst and leverage should match conviction; with a binary NFP print tomorrow and equities extended at record highs, a 3x SPXL/SOXL/TQQQ bet carries outsized overnight gap risk for low edge. Spot BTC (~2–3%/day vol vs 4–6%+ for 3x ETFs) sidesteps both the equity jobs-gap and tonight's tech earnings, while still offering upside toward $66–67k on constructive momentum + ETF inflows. Chose spot over BITX (2x BTC) because event risk argues against leverage; over SPXL/SPY long (extended, NFP-exposed); over SOXS/SQQQ inverse (fighting a firm NVDA-led tape and a record-high broad market — low edge). Entry 64,572.97 = canonical proxy asOf 2026-08-06T11:43:56Z (fresh, ~2 min old). Stop 58,115.67 (-10%, matched to spot-crypto overnight vol).
positions.risks: Spot crypto still carries overnight gap risk and is macro-sensitive: a hot or cold NFP tomorrow could swing BTC via the dollar/rates channel (risk-off = BTC down toward $62.7k support then the $58.1k stop). A broad risk-on equity melt-up continuing would mean BTC underperforms a 3x equity long (opportunity cost). Momentum is 'balanced/waiting on a catalyst,' so range-bound chop is the base case. Mitigants: 1x (no leverage) is the biggest downside protection; not exposed to tonight's ABNB/LYFT/NET earnings; defined -10% stop + daily rotation caps loss; support shelf at $63.9k/$62.7k below entry.
